notes: The booklet has two models: Speed Racer's Mach 5 (white car, parts b1-b87 plus groups bumper and axle) and the Snake Oiler (orange car, parts b88-b196 plus group axleb). The parts list does not say which model each piece belongs to, so I assigned pieces by colour and by the pictures.
The minifigure parts (heads, torsos, legs, helmets) are not in the official parts list, so I left them out.
The sticker sheet is one node (b23). It is joined to each part that carries a sticker. Several stickers are on the same sheet, so it has many edges.

The step pictures are small and many pieces look alike (dark grey against black, light grey against white). The piece-to-piece pairings, especially for the upper body panels, curved bricks and arches, are best-effort readings. The colour and type of every piece follow the parts list.
Where a piece sits across two parts, I gave it a joined edge to both.
The two Speed Racer sub-assemblies (rear cockpit, front nose) meet at step 13. I joined them through b38-b11 and b40-b9.
The step-9 Z-brackets are lego-6087. Two are used in each model.
Axles run through Technic-brick pin holes (revolute). The wheel, tyre, cover and bush pairings follow the 1:1 axle diagram on pages 13 and 28.
Edge ports are mostly null because the pictures do not show which stud is used.
